Every message application_id and sender_id resolves and every sender is permitted to write there per hireops_rules.md:131-134 (recruiters; owning candidate); every note author is a recruiter or that job's manager (MGR1 on JOB-PLAT, MGR3 on JOB-DSGN) per hireops_rules.md:104-105; no blank bodies; per-thread timestamps strictly increasing and unique; APP-101 has 120 messages as stated in tests/app_context.md:29-30. Read markers all resolve, read_count within 0..len(thread), candidate markers only on own threads (hireops_rules.md:207-208 semantics). Cross-file seed facts re-derived: Lena's starting unread = 1 (CAN3 read 2 of 3, msg 3 by REC3) matches tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:25 and judge.toml:335; seeded Platform Engineer order Applied Greta/Ade/Marco, Screen Priya/Samuel and Noor's note text match prompt.md:25 and judge.toml:407. Adversarial: a broken app cannot exploit the seed (no injection text to render, no pre-overfilled Interview, no orphan to crash on); a conforming app that loads markers literally or as last-read-message-id gets the same unread counts (verified both readings agree for all 6 markers). Note (not a defect): USR-CAN1's marker is 119/120 and USR-REC3's 2/3 although each sent the last message of that thread, so the literal markers lag 'sending counts as having read' (hireops_rules.md:153); because own messages are never unread, unread and seen outcomes are identical either way, and no criterion reads those counts.
